debug_processes.Name: pwsh.exe
debug_processes.CommandLine:
"C:\Users\22061\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\powershell\pwsh.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$servers=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(hw_server|cs_server|xsdb|xsct|vivado|vitis|pwsh)\.exe$' -and ($_.Name -ne 'pwsh.exe' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'capture_uart') } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine,@{Name='CreationTimeFileTimeUtc';Expression={[string]$_.CreationDate.ToFileTimeUtc()}})
$ports=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_SerialPort | Select-Object DeviceID,Name,PNPDeviceID,Status)
$listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3121 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess)
[pscustomobject]@{checked_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o');debug_processes=$servers;serial_ports=$ports;listeners=$listeners} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6"

serial_ports.Name: Silicon Labs CP210x USB to UART Bridge (COM4)
